name: Temp file cleanup
description: Lists stale files in a temp folder (your OS temp directory by default) and proposes deleting them. Always previews the exact file list first (dry run) and only deletes after you approve.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY wants to DELETE {count} stale temp file(s) ({size}) from “{folder}” older than {olderThanDays} days. This is permanent. Review the previewed list before allowing.
